recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for current core FHIR source unless a future policy explicitly requires rewriting historical release snapshot files.
issue_request: FHIR-15875 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive technical correction for FHIR-core Claim. It reported that the Claim.related structure definition short text said "Related Claims which may be revelant to processing this claimn", with "claimn" misspelled and "revelant" also incorrect.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-15875 was found, but 9c5ccc262465eea2808c91ec3c0c0f54e21ec46c corrected the pre-rework Claim spreadsheet short from "revelant"/"claimn" to "relevant"/"claim" as part of QA changes. Later Claim work in afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a replaced that short with the current "Prior or corollary claims" wording and a clearer definition.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini, and after the 2021 source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 the authoritative current source is source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml. Repository typo searches found no current-source matches outside excluded publish/history material; remaining matches are limited to tools/history/release3/profiles-resources.xml, a historical generated release snapshot. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant human discussion or work-group minutes changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the active current Claim source already satisfies the Jira request and historical release snapshots are not current build source.
